description: The best of the four, which is a claim about the other three. A proper fireplace with the grate still in it, a picture rail all the way round, and a hairline crack from the corner of the window to the ceiling that the landlord describes as historic.

window.description: A corner window catching light from two directions, which in the Filaments is close to a luxury.
window.name: the corner window
